storage.note: Total deploy bytes = packed weights + FP scales/biases + non-packed FP params. No FP32 master weights are retained.

inference.note: Packing saves storage; expanding bits costs time on CPU.

binary_compute_boundary.note: One-bit × one-bit only. The ASR model has FP activations, so this kernel cannot replace BitLinear without also binarizing activations (a different model with different accuracy).

conclusion: 1-bit storage is real (packed payload); compute is not accelerated for this model because activations are FP and the runtime expands weights before F.linear. XNOR+popcount works only for 1-bit×1-bit.
